metadata.name: California Aeronautics A&D Grant Priority
metadata.agency: Caltrans Division of Aeronautics; California Transportation Commission (CTC)
metadata.source_citation: Caltrans Aeronautics Capital Improvement Plan, June 2025 adoption. Source PDF: https://dot.ca.gov/-/media/dot-media/programs/aeronautics/documents/airport-cip/4-11-aeronautics-cip-for-adoption-june-2025-combined-a11y.pdf. Project category priority order: Safety > Capacity > Security, plus additional inputs from Caltrans Office of Airports and sponsor.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 8 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded California as multiplicative model with 3 stated priority categories (safety/capacity/security) at the top of the criterion list and 2 supplementary criteria for inspection reports and sponsor input.
decisions_log.rationale: Caltrans Aeronautics ACIP explicitly states: 'A&D grants are selected from the CIP using the Commission-approved Priority List in the order of safety, capacity, and security.' Multiplicative captures the strong priority ordering.

criteria.label: Project Category (CTC Priority List)
criteria.description: California Transportation Commission-approved priority order. Safety highest, then Capacity, then Security. One category selected.

subcategories.label: Capacity
subcategories.condition: Second CTC priority. Capacity additions or improvements.

subcategories.label: Preservation (supplementary)
subcategories.condition: Pavement and asset preservation (Caltrans Office of Airports input).

criteria.label: Safety Inspection Report Findings
criteria.description: Caltrans Aeronautics safety inspection findings can elevate project priority within a category.

subcategories.label: Project addresses a recent inspection finding
Project maintains state airport permit compliance

criteria.label: Sponsor Input / Local Support
criteria.description: Caltrans Office of Airports also considers sponsor input as a selection factor.

criteria.label: California Aviation System Plan Alignment
criteria.description: Project advances California Aviation System Plan objectives.

subcategories.label: Consistent with current Master Plan / ALP

governance.statute_citation: Streets and Highways Code Section 21601 et seq.; Public Utilities Code Aeronautics Act
governance.scoring_authority: Caltrans Division of Aeronautics, Office of Airports
governance.approval_process: Caltrans Aeronautics prepares ACIP. CTC adopts annually. A&D (Acquisition and Development) grants drawn from CIP in stated priority order.

disclaimer: Encoded from publicly available Caltrans ACIP June 2025 document. Caltrans documents only the conceptual priority order (Safety > Capacity > Security) plus reference to inspection reports and sponsor input; numerical scoring is internal. Point values shown are inferred to preserve the documented priority order. California stakeholders should calibrate to Caltrans internal scoring matrix before adoption.
